KPMG forensic review (Dec 18, 2020) confirmed exactly 5 donations to IPI totaling $650,000 from Epstein-controlled entities between 2010-2020: (1) Enhanced Education $125,000 on Oct 11, 2011 for 'WK Rick Hooper fellowship'; (2) Gratitude America $150,000 on May 8, 2017 labeled 'Reimbursement of tickets to the Oslo Play'; (3) Gratitude America $125,000 on Jun 12, 2017; (4) Gratitude America $100,000 on Nov 1, 2017 labeled 'Contribution from Gatitude [sic] America, LTD Oslo Play'; (5) Gratitude America $150,000 on Apr 5, 2019 (3 months before arrest). KPMG also found one flight reimbursement of $14,158.88 from Enhanced Education on Mar 28, 2014 for 'L. Summers flight'. Total Epstein-related financial flow through IPI: $664,158.88.

The 'Oslo Play' was used as justification for $250,000 in payments from Gratitude America to IPI in 2017. Two checks totaling $250K: $150K on May 8, 2017 ('Reimbursement of tickets to the Oslo Play') and $100K on Nov 1, 2017 ('Contribution from Gatitude America, LTD Oslo Play'). The Broadway play 'Oslo' by J.T. Rogers premiered at Lincoln Center in June 2016 and transferred to Broadway in April 2017. Rod-Larsen hosted a private cocktail reception before a May 5, 2017 performance (EFTA02650430). Epstein 'hired out the entire theatre for the U.N.' (EFTA02650158). However, $250K for theater tickets is wildly disproportionate. KPMG noted no donor restrictions on these contributions, meaning IPI could use the funds for any purpose. This pattern suggests the 'Oslo Play' label may have been a pretext for unrestricted charitable donations.

Leon Black donated $200,000 to IPI in December 2014. The donation letter (EFTA02705181) from Black at 760 Park Avenue was addressed to 'Terje Rod-Larsen, President, International Peace Institute, Inc., 777 United Nations Plaza 4th Floor, New York, NY 10017-3521.' This donation was separate from Black's $10M to Gratitude America (Oct 2015), which subsequently made its own donations to IPI. On April 4, 2019, Klein emailed Camilla Reksten-Monsen (Rod-Larsen's special assistant at IPI) requesting IPI bank instructions and 501c3 certification. Reksten-Monsen provided IPI's JPMorgan Chase account details. Klein responded: 'I will send check tomorrow AM' to IPI's offices at 777 UN Plaza (EFTA02282103). Klein preferred to 'send an overnight check or deliver check via messenger' rather than wire (EFTA02280923). This was the last Epstein-related donation to IPI. The timing -- April 2019, with SDNY investigation already underway -- raises questions about whether this was a final disbursement before anticipated legal proceedings.

Checks: EFTA01357084 (May 8 2017, 150K), EFTA01360128 (Jun 12 2017, 125K), EFTA01362195 (Nov 1 2017, 100K). Epstein constructed a comprehensive Norwegian power network spanning: (1) DIPLOMACY: Rod-Larsen (IPI head, UN Coordinator) + Mona Juul (Ambassador); (2) POLITICS: Jagland (PM, Nobel Chairman, CoE SG); (3) FINANCE/INDUSTRY: Morits Skaugen (shipping magnate); (4) GLOBAL GOVERNANCE: Borge Brende (WEF President, FM); (5) LEGAL: Kare Moljord (Supreme Court lawyer). As of Feb 2026, Norwegian state response includes: Juul charged with gross corruption, Rod-Larsen with aiding, Jagland investigated for aggravated corruption, WEF probing Brende, Moljord resigned from government board, Crown Princess Mette-Marit also implicated.

Debra and Leon Black Family Foundation (EIN 13-3947890) at 445 Park Ave, c/o Elysium. Black Family Foundation grant timing analysis: 2011 K grants, 2012 M grants, 2013 .5M grants, 2014 .76M grants (SPIKE - 10x increase), 2015 .93M grants, 2019 .81M grants. The 2014 spike to .76M in grants paid is extraordinary. Since Gratitude America received .003M in its 2015 tax year, and the Black Foundation paid .76M in its 2014 tax year, the timing aligns with a late-2014 or early-2015 transfer. The M Gratitude America contribution was approximately 85% of the Black Foundation total 2014 grants.

LOBBYING FOOTPRINT SYNTHESIS: The Epstein network shows a distinctive pattern of influence outside formal lobbying channels. Key findings: (1) ZERO LDA filings for Epstein personally, IPI, HDI, Gratitude America, Enhanced Education, Leon Black Foundation, or any Epstein-named entity. (2) Apollo Global (Leon Black) spent 1.21M on lobbying in 2019 (278% increase from 2018), with Q4 2019 alone at 670K. (3) Deutsche Bank lobbied on AML regulation in 2007 while maintaining 40+ Epstein accounts. (4) Ken Starr was registered at Kirkland Ellis but Epstein lobbying appears unregistered. (5) Carbyne (Barak) lobbied actively 2021-2025 on Next Gen 911. (6) L Brands (Wexner) had 784 filings with massive political contributions. (7) IPI and HDI zero-filing status despite 33+ Congress members is the most significant red flag - potential LDA violations. (8) See Forever Foundation (Weingarten) used Squire Patton Boggs with Clinton-era lobbyist Rodney Slater. Pattern: Epstein's influence was deliberately structured to avoid lobbying disclosure requirements, operating through nonprofits, personal relationships, and legal counsel rather than registered lobbying contacts.

Leon Black operated TWO foundations at the same 445 Park Ave address c/o Elysium: (1) Debra and Leon Black Family Foundation (EIN 13-3947890) - large pass-through grants vehicle, and (2) Leon D. Black Foundation (EIN 20-5117734) - smaller arts/culture foundation. Combined grant-making: Family Foundation paid .76M in 2014, .93M in 2015, .81M in 2019, then essentially ceased. Leon D. Black Foundation continued at K-.6M/yr through 2023. The Family Foundation was the vehicle for the M Gratitude America transfer and is now nearly depleted (K assets). The personal foundation continues. This dual structure provided layered opacity for different scales of giving.

FEC analysis reveals ZERO donations from employees of Gratitude America, Enhanced Education, DKIP, or Financial Trust Company. These core Epstein entities had no political footprint via employer-based donations. The ONLY Epstein entities appearing in FEC employer fields are: J Epstein and Company/Epstein and Company Inc (Jeffrey's donations 1994-2000), New York Strategy Group (Indyke, Groff, Schantz), Ossa Properties (Barrett, Mark Epstein), and RDK Properties (Kahn). The absence of donations from Gratitude America employees is notable given its M endowment from Leon Black.

February 1-2, 2017 was the HIGHEST-VOLUME single date cluster in the DS10 dataset, with over $52M in outgoing transactions across multiple entities in 48 hours. DETAILED BREAKDOWN: Feb 1: Plan D LLC $46,300,000 to Bank of America (EFTA01296638), Plan D LLC $1,000,000 to Bank of America (EFTA01286637), FT Real Estate $1,500,000 self-transfer (EFTA00), FT Real Estate $1,500,000 incoming from unknown (EFTA00130829). Feb 2: FT Real Estate $280,000 outgoing to unknown. The $47.3M Plan D outflow to Bank of America on a single day represents the single largest daily flow in the entire dataset. This concentration on Feb 1 is followed by: Feb 21 — $15K wire from Gratitude America to Coutts & Co. A/C PETER FENWICK (British neuropsychiatrist, consciousness research grant), Feb 27 — $20,011,000 UNKNOWN entity internal transfer plus Plan D $116.7K, LSJE operational payments. The Feb 2017 total monthly outflow exceeds $70M. This month marks the transition: STC balance had dropped from peak to $18M (May 2017), Plan D was draining its BV70 loan proceeds, and the entire DB relationship was winding down. DB compliance was simultaneously questioning the BV70 incoming wire (EFTA02654334).

DS10 records a $15,000 wire on February 21, 2017 from GRATITUDE AMERICA, LTD to COUTTS AND CO. A/C PETER FENWICK (EFTA01296855). Peter Fenwick is a British neuropsychiatrist known for consciousness and near-death experience research. Multiple Epstein-Fenwick emails confirm the relationship: EFTA02343953 (Oct 2017 NYC visit), EFTA02348505 (Apr 2017 grant administration discussion with options including 'the Network' educational trust and La Laguna). The payment was a scientific research grant routed through Gratitude America, Epstein's Leon Black-funded charity vehicle at Deutsche Bank. The Gratitude America statement (EFTA01296855) also shows: $25K to Cancer Research via BofA CA, $25K to Mind Education and Research via UBI Banca Italy, $125K to MIT via BofA, $50K to Wellness Institute, $150K to The New School, $15K to International Friends of the Elton, $50K to International Police and Fire Chapel via BofA, $100K checks. Black 'felt comfortable making this donation because he understood that Epstein was a strong proponent of scientific innovation.' Separately, a letter from Gratitude America to Black dated August 21, 2015 thanked him for a $5 million donation (confirmed by email from Epstein to Black), but Dechert found no bank record or Family Office document confirming this $5M payment. This suggests Black donated $10M-$15M to Gratitude America in 2015 alone. Gratitude America 2015 990-PF shows $10,007,332 revenue. Dechert also noted Black made donations at Epstein's request to MIT, Harvard, Arizona State Origins Project, and Peace Initiative Foundation.

Brockman+Matson run Edge Foundation. Cwerman runs HDI with Mark Epstein on board. Apollo executives Hannan+Cohen on Black Foundation board. (5) KEY DATES: Black $10M to Gratitude (Oct 2015). Gratitude $1.26M grants (2017). Gratitude $891K grants (2018). HDI flagged for excess benefit transaction (2015). Edge Foundation received $35K from Gratitude (2018) while itself making zero grants.

The 'Coutts PETER' payments in DS10 are identified as a $15,000 grant from Gratitude America, Ltd to Peter Fenwick (British neuropsychiatrist) at Coutts and Co. on February 21, 2017. The bank statement (EFTA01296855, Gratitude America account Jan-Jun 2017) shows: 'TO COUTTS AND CO. A/C PETER FENWICK' for $15,000. Network, 2. La Laguna (without Goldsmiths), 3. Pay to me and I will administer grant. But I am not a charity.'). The grant was routed through Gratitude America, Epstein's Leon Black-funded charity vehicle at Deutsche Bank. This represents Epstein funding consciousness research through his charity infrastructure.

BV70 LLC was an entity owned by Leon Black used to make two loans to Epstein's Plan D LLC: $22.5M on 3/31/2017 and $8M on 4/17/2017, totaling $30.5M. Listed as 'NC' (not a charity) on 990-PF — not a US 501(c)(3). Address: Via Tuscolana 1000, Rome, Italy. Run by Professor Giuseppe Bersani of Sapienza University Rome. Bersani requested EUR 15,000 for Cuba congress budget deficit, providing Italian IBAN. Pattern: Epstein used Gratitude America to fund a non-US entity with no 501(c)(3) status, organizing events in Cuba during US embargo period, channeled through personal academic contacts.

The project represented Epstein's attempt to create a PBS-branded science series where he would have creative influence over participant selection and episode topics, effectively laundering his reputation through association with Nobel laureates and leading scientists.
